text:
maria-cs: FYI — Customer Delta opened a ticket: per-model throughput panels in Console show flatlines since ~03:20 UTC. Total throughput line still shows activity. Delta says it's affecting dashboards only.

monitoring-bot: Alert: grafana.dashboard:panel(throughput_per_model)=no_series at 2026-03-17T03:21:12Z : investigate

jess: I'm seeing same in staging dashboards. Might be a metric dimension rename from exporter after last deploy. Going to check Prometheus scrape.

omar: Repro steps for us:
1) kubectl -n monitoring exec -it prometheus-0 -- curl -s "localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query='redwood_model_qps'" | jq .
2) kubectl -n infra exec -it rwd-exporter-0 -- curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep model

kyle: Running grep on prod exporter shows metric names shifted:
Old: redwood_model_qps{model="gpt-..."} 123
New: rwd_model_rate{model_id="gpt-..."} 123

jess: Aha — dashboards use label 'model' and metric name redwood_model_qps. Exporter now emits rwd_model_rate and label 'model_id'. That's why series keyed by 'model' collapsed.

maria-cs: Customer-visible impact: graphs per-model flatline, health checks fine, API latency unchanged. They care about Console reporting

omar: Quick mitigation options:
- Update Grafana dashboards to use rwd_model_rate and model_id (short-term)
- Add Prometheus relabel or recording rule mapping rwd_model_rate{...} -> redwood_model_qps{model=...} (fastest for many dashboards)
- Roll exporter back (riskier)

kyle: Patch for recording rule (prometheus rules):
```
- record: redwood_model_qps
  expr: rwd_model_rate
```
We also need to copy label:
```
expr: rwd_model_rate{model_id=~".+"}
labels:
  model: '{{ $labels.model_id }}'
```

jess: I'll push a recording rule to dev, test, then prod. Omar — can you hold off rollback? We should try recording rule first.

omar: Yep. Applying in prod now. Command:
kubectl -n monitoring apply -f /tmp/recording-rule.yaml
Then reload Prometheus: kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart statefulset prometheus

monitoring-bot: Prometheus config reload accepted (03:47 UTC)

kyle: After reload I see per-model series reappear in Console. Doing a sanity check on last 15m panels.

maria-cs: Customer updated: dashboards returned. Thanks. They want root cause.

jess: Root cause: exporter refactor in release v2.9 changed metric prefix and renamed label. PR didn't include a compatibility shim or dashboard update.

maria-cs: Next actions:
- eng-ml / infra coordinate to add compatibility layer in exporter (owner: jess)
- Update Console's dashboard queries to accept both names (owner: kyle)
- Add automated alert when per-model-panel has zero distinct series for >5m (owner: omar)
- Postmortem draft in #postmortems (author: maria-cs)

omar: I'll add a small datapoint test in CI that pulls /metrics and ensures model label present.

kyle: Also add a migration checklist for metric renames (docs + changelog).

maria-cs: tagging eng-ml and infra leads for visibility @jess @omar @kyle :exclamation:

support-bot: Ticket #4521 updated: "Console throughput graphs recovered after temporary recording rule."

maria-cs: closing loop — please update here when PRs merged.
